33 Seconds of Chaos - Rules

Overview

On your turn, you'll choose between two ways to get everyone to guess your word. Take the easier word, but follow a RULE that restricts your clues, or take the harder word and give your clues while playing a ridiculous ROLE.

Sometimes you'll draw a RUMBLE! instead, where two players go head-to-head to be the first to name 3 things that fit the challenge.

Setup & Components

Components: 362 cards & a 33-second timer

Shuffle all three decks separately, then place the TAKE ME deck in the center with the RULE and ROLE decks on either side. The most chaotic person goes first.

Choose your word. Take the easier word and follow a RULE about how you can give clues, or take the harder word and play a ridiculous ROLE.

Draw the matching prompt and read it out loud. When ready, flip the 33-second timer and start giving clues. Everyone else shouts guesses.

If someone guesses correctly before time runs out, you keep the TAKE ME card and they get the Prompt.

If more than one player guesses correctly, every correct guesser gets a card, taking any extras from the TAKE ME deck. If nobody guesses correctly before time runs out, discard both cards.

DON’T

  • Say any part of the word
  • Spell anything out
  • Say “rhymes with”
  • Use gestures, pointing, or charades

Rumble!

example-v1

The player who drew the card is the Judge. The players to their left and right are the duelers.

The Judge reads the card out loud. The duelers race to name 3 things that fit the challenge.

The first player to 3 wins. The Judge keeps the RUMBLE! card.

If duelers reach 3 at the same time, both win. Winner(s) take a card from the TAKE ME deck for scoring.

Rumble Rules

  • No repeats.
  • If both duelers say the same answer at the same time, it doesn’t count for either player.
  • No Double-Dipping: If the challenge includes a letter, you can’t reuse the same word as part of multiple answers. For example, apple juice and apple pie only count as one.
  • Any disputes are settled by the Judge. Their decision is final, even if it’s hilariously wrong.

Winning the Game

Play passes clockwise until everyone has taken 3 turns.

The player with the most cards wins.

If there’s a tie, settle it with a RUMBLE!

Keep It Moving: If a card just isn’t working for you, discard it and draw another from the same deck.
